target.statement: Isolation forest prediction time for 10^6 samples with 2 features using coniferest 0.0.13 (single thread) on Apple M3 Pro, as shown in Figure 1.
target.dataset: synthetic dataset of 10^6 samples with 2 features

compute.basis: The target is a timing benchmark of a single-threaded prediction on a synthetic dataset; the code is available and the dataset can be generated, so the main cost is installing the package and running the benchmark, which should take a few minutes on a laptop.

title: Coniferest: a complete active anomaly detection framework
